This leaks information from the validation folds into the training folds, making the out-of-fold validation scores overly optimistic.

summary: The agent provides a highly sophisticated and robust solution with extensive feature engineering and an advanced stacking ensemble. However, there is cross-fold data leakage because several global transformations (like TF-IDF and aggregations) are applied to the entire training set before CV splitting. Additionally, the agent hardcodes the submission IDs, which will likely result in an evaluation failure on platforms expecting exact original identifiers.
